text: Use multi-stage builds to keep runtime images small and deterministic. Pin base image tags and remove package manager caches.
Set requests and limits for CPU and memory to avoid noisy-neighbor effects and OOM kills. Prefer readiness probes for rollout safety.
Use journalctl, top, vmstat, and /proc/meminfo to diagnose memory and CPU pressure quickly on small instances.
Use remote state with locking, module version pinning, and plan/apply separation in CI for safe infrastructure changes.
For low-memory servers, avoid large dependency graphs, precompile TypeScript, and use clustering cautiously because of per-process overhead.
Cache dependencies and build artifacts. Instrument p95 latency and error rate. Use canary rollouts and automatic rollback signals.
